Genesis 1:1.title: Genesis 1:1
Genesis 1:1.content: Matthew Henry notes that the Bible begins with God, teaching us that all things originate from Him and exist for His glory.

John 3:16.title: John 3:16
John 3:16.content: Matthew Henry emphasizes the greatness of God's love in giving His Son for the salvation of sinners.

Romans 8:1.title: Romans 8:1
Romans 8:1.content: Matthew Henry highlights the comfort believers have in Christ, being free from condemnation through His finished work.
